disposition_reason: Methods-validation paper for TXRF that also reports per-gram lead, arsenic, chromium and mercury in four Mexican dietary supplements and solution concentrations for two Spanish supplements.

study.design: Analytical method validation with application to six commercial dietary supplements
study.market: Local suppliers in Mexico (A-01 to A-04) and Spain (A-05, A-06)
study.method: HNO3+HCl+H2O2 digestion (80 °C water bath, 8 h); TXRF (S2 PICOFOX) with Ga internal standard; ICP-OES comparison for two samples
study.lod_text: LOD (µg/L in solution): Pb 0.59, As 0.41, Cr 0.57, Hg 0.75; LOQ: Pb 1.95, As 1.35, Cr 1.90, Hg 2.50
study.qa: BCR-610 groundwater CRM: Pb 7.85 vs 7.78 µg/L certified, As 10.79 vs 10.40 µg/L; spike recoveries 91-108% (Table 5)
